ADMISSION 21 ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR APPLYING FOR B.DES

Only those students who have passed Class XII (or equivalent) in the year 2026 or are appearing in the year 2027, in ANY STREAM (Science, Commerce, or Arts & Humanities) for the first time are eligible to appear for the UCEED 2027 [For complete details, see the “ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR APPEARING…
However, the aspirants should have qualified UCEED in the same year
6.12 To be considered for seat allocation, foreign national candidates should have an All India Rank (AIR) and satisfy all the eligibility requirements meant for an OPEN category candidate
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR APPEARING IN UCEED 2027 A candidate, including a foreign national, must simultaneously fulfil every one of the following three criteria to appear in UCEED 2027
The candidate should have been born on or after October 1, 2002, if belonging to the OPEN/EWS/OBC-NCL category and born on or after October 1, 1997, if belonging to the SC, ST or PwD category
(i) A candidate should have appeared for the Class XII (or equivalent) examination for the first time in either 2026 OR 2027 to be eligible for attempting UCEED 2027

However, if the examination Board of Class XII (or equivalent) declared the results for the academic year 2024-25 on or after September 30, 2025, then the candidates of that Board who appeared for their Class XII (or equivalent) examination in 2025 are also eligible to appear in UCEED 2027,…
● In case the Class XII examination is not a public examination, the candidate must have already passed at least one public (Board or Pre-University) examination before appearing for UCEED
9.2 Candidates should simultaneously satisfy ALL the THREE eligibility criteria [Refer ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR APPEARING IN UCEED 2027]

value.evidence: The B.Des. curriculum has a four-level structure leading to a gradual movement from general, foundational courses at level 1 to more specialized inputs at level 4
As the student moves upwards from level 1 to level 2, the student graduates to choosing between courses which offer different kinds of skills from soft to hard
The courses at level 1 would help the students to choose the mix of skills they prefer to acquire
At level 3, it is hoped that the student is ready to fine tune a certain mix or a set of skills into a specialization
At Level 4, the student employs all that has been gained regarding skills and understanding and applies or uses them in independent projects
